items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the internal hom from a K-flat complex into a K-injective complex is K-injective (statement lines 8788-8795). The proof (proof lines 8797-8826) is a four-term computation of the homotopy Hom group out of an acyclic complex: the global-cohomology equation and the composition lemma rewrite it as a Hom into the K-injective complex from Tot(K^bullet tensor L^bullet), which is acyclic because L^bullet is K-flat, so the group vanishes. H2: one computation with two identifications, written out.
